name: Jamba-1.5-Large
attention_variant: hybrid: interleaved Transformer + Mamba blocks with MoE
notes: ai21labs/AI21-Jamba-Large-1.5 returned HTTP 401 on a direct config read this session, so the attention geometry of the Jamba-1.5-Large could not be machine-verified. Left null. The sibling LFM2 and Falcon-H1 hybrids in this set show that the pattern (num_key_value_heads 2-8, head_dim 64-128 on a minority of layers) is knowable only from the config, not inferred from the family, so no value is assumed here. 94B active parameters per the Jamba-1.5 paper (arXiv:2408.12570). The original Jamba (arXiv:2403.19887) states the design goal: 'Trading off attention layers for Mamba layers reduces the total size of the KV cache. Our architecture aims to provide not only a small number of active parameters but also an 8x smaller KV cache compared to a vanilla Transformer of comparable size.' The 52B Jamba-v0.1 configuration uses roughly a 1:3 Mamba:Transformer block ratio. Jamba-1.5 adds ExpertsInt8 quantization. 256K effective context. The exact layer counts and KV head geometry for Jamba-1.5-Large could not be verified from the config.json (HuggingFace returns 404 for the raw config), so kv_cache_bytes_per_token is null. The 8x KV reduction claim is relative to a vanilla Transformer of comparable size, not an absolute number.
